expected_response.note: Incumbent retained; no registered bounded declarative edit has a defensible expected advantage on the affinity-primary objective given the supplied evidence.

failure_modes: No permitted edit is connected by a registered formula to the pair_kernel/joint-RMS observables that carry the strongest adjusted support; editing an unread parameter would not be operative.
Landmark enrichment contrasts are standardized selection contrasts, not absolute geometric quality; a region_index edit could displace surrounding coordinates without an affinity benefit.

Temporal contrast curves have many sign changes, strong sign conflicts and large relative node RMSE with no accepted polynomial and no extrapolation, so a temporal_teacher_blend edit is not selected by the evidence.

Selection enrichment and recorded descendant survival credit disagree in sign, and decoded terminal affinity labels are unavailable, so a directional edit could follow survivor-biased joint-head credit rather than final affinity.
Turnover residuals include score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, so they cannot justify a causal selection edit.
Joint diagnostics are descriptive within-selector associations with only three null-tested rows, so they cannot support a causal module or rigid-motion claim.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's own evidence does not establish a defensible expected advantage for any registered bounded edit, and the objective is final predicted target affinity, which is not measured here. (1) The strongest selection-enrichment signals are pair_kernel_1.5/2.5/3.5/5.0 and landmark soft_mass at landmarks 00,07,10,17 (endpoint_effects:9-12,15; regional_effects:0,70,100,170), and the only large-magnitude adjusted effects with consistent sign across raw and adjusted covariance are pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 and the joint RMS innovation/internal terms (branch_adjusted:86,87,240,241,151,153,305,307,74,76,228,230). However, the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit; Analyst limitation), so no permitted edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) is connected to those observables by a registered formula. Editing a parameter that the instantiated reward does not read would not be an operative edit. (2) The permitted region_index/temporal_region_index edits bind to an evidence-bound landmark, but the landmark evidence is enrichment contrast on a standardized feature scale, not an absolute geometric descriptor or a favorable direction (observable_definitions), and the landmark occupancy/softmin terms are radial shell densities and normalized soft-min distances, not quality axes. (3) The permitted temporal_teacher_blend edit is supported only by observed-node linear contrasts with many sign changes and strong sign conflicts and large relative node RMSE (continuous:1,7,17; curve_support), with no extrapolation allowed and no accepted polynomial; a time-conditioned rule is indicated but the evidence does not select a blend value or establish affinity benefit. (4) The permitted pointcloud_delta_A edit changes the executing curvature, but no supplied evidence compares delta values on the affinity objective; the default 1 A is the frozen program value. (5) The permitted teacher_neighbors edit changes a count, not a distance bandwidth (formula_registry prior; teacher_modes), and no evidence ranks k=2/4/8 on the objective. (6) Directional conflict remains: selection enrichment and recorded descendant survival credit disagree in sign for several observables (survival_effects:0,70,100,186 vs 46,56,96,146,156,166,195), and decoded terminal affinity labels are unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available false; lineage_support), so last-record joint-head credit cannot be treated as final-affinity benefit. (7) Turnover residuals are accounting diagnostics including score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not causal selection effects (turnover:13,14,16,17,223,224,87,88,89,375,376,377; limitations). (8) Joint diagnostics are descriptive within-selector associations, only three rows null-tested (joint_diagnostics:1,2,11), and the teacher contrast is predominantly internal (joint_diagnostics:14) with smaller translation/rotation fractions (joint_diagnostics:12,13), which argues for retaining surrounding-coordinate freedom rather than a rigid or narrow-neighborhood edit. Temperatures are immutable fixed parameters (fixed_parameters) and are not proposed. Retaining the incumbent is the defensible choice; the evidence that would change this decision is a registered formula linking a permitted parameter to the affinity objective, or decoded terminal affinity labels showing a consistent direction.
